title: Approximate tangent spaces survive removal of a locally null set
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ. Let M, M' ⊆ ℝ^P with M Borel and M' ⊆ M (M' is otherwise arbitrary). Let x ∈ ℝ^P and δ > 0 with Hⁿ((M ∖ M') ∩ B_δ(x)) = 0, where Hⁿ = μHE[n] and B_δ(x) is the open ball. Let Q be a linear subspace of ℝ^P. Suppose Q is the approximate tangent space of M at x in the sense of Simon Ch. 3, Definition 1.4: HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x Q, meaning finrank Q = n and ∫_{η_{x,λ}(M)} f dHⁿ → ∫_Q f dHⁿ as λ ↓ 0 for all f ∈ C_c(ℝ^P, ℝ), where η_{x,λ}(y) = λ⁻¹(y − x). Then Q is the approximate tangent space of M' at x: HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M' x Q.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (M M' : Set (Euclid P)) (x : Euclid P) (δ : ℝ) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), MeasurableSet M → M' ⊆ M → 0 < δ → μHE[n] ((M \ M') ∩ ball x δ) = 0 → HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x Q → HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M' x Q
